summary: sysb1 captures screen, clipboard, and UI text and exfiltrates to hardcoded endpoint
details: Package is published as a 'System binary configuration tool' but its bin/main entry launches a bundled pointer.py that captures the installer's screen (mss/ImageGrab), clipboard content, and UIAutomation-extracted on-screen text via global keyboard hooks and POSTs the data to a hardcoded author-controlled endpoint at https://iq-overlay-pointer.vercel.app/api. The pipeline includes a stealth Tk overlay with overrideredirect + transparentcolor and empty window titles, and panic-exit hotkeys; source comments reference 'ULTRA GHOST MODE'. index.js runs at startup to silently install Python (winget, falling back to a /quiet python.org installer download to %TEMP%) and then launches start_tool.vbs, which uses ShellExecute with verb 'runas' and window state 0 to spawn cmd.exe hidden and elevated to run pointer.py. The package description and keywords do not disclose screen/clipboard capture, keystroke hooks, elevation, or upload to a remote endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
